snippet.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - SpongeBob SquarePants Pack Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time for the moment you've been waiting for...!
 
SpongeBob SquarePants is joining Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds on November 19th!

Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now: RaceCrossWorlds.com
